title: Fracciones 1: Mis primeras fracciones
subtitle: Aprende qué es una fracción, cómo se lee y escribe, y cómo comparar fracciones que valen lo mismo

audience.rationale: SEP Fase 4 introduces fractions as equal parts of a whole and equal sharing in 3rd grade, so Book 1 builds foundational part-whole and measurement meaning before formal operations with unlike denominators.

series.focus: Introductory foundations: fractions as equal parts of a whole and equal sharing, reading/writing fractions, numerator/denominator meaning, unit fractions, fractions on the 0-1 number line and as part of a set, comparing with same denominator or same numerator, and visual introduction to equivalent fractions (proper fractions ≤ 1 only)

Intermediate development: improper fractions and mixed numbers, formal equivalent fractions by amplification and simplification, comparing and ordering with unlike denominators, and addition and subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with like and unlike denominators

Advanced operations and connections: multiplication and division of fractions, fractions as division (quotient), fraction-decimal-percentage relationships, and multi-step problem solving with measurement, ratio and proportion

intro.title: ¡Bienvenido a tu libro de fracciones!
intro.text: En este libro vas a descubrir las fracciones jugando y compartiendo. Verás cómo se usan al partir una pizza, repartir galletas o medir con tiras. Usarás dibujos, barras y rectas para entender muy bien cada idea. ¡Tú puedes hacerlo paso a paso!

units.title: Unidad 1: Partes iguales y fracciones
units.summary: Vas a aprender qué es una fracción cuando divides algo en partes iguales y cómo se lee y se escribe.
objectives: Identificar si una figura está dividida en partes iguales
Leer y escribir fracciones como 1/2, 1/4 y 3/4
Explicar qué indica el numerador y qué indica el denominador

lessons.title: Lección 1: Repartos justos y partes iguales
lessons.goal: Understand that a fraction requires dividing a whole into equal parts
lessons.approach: Equal-sharing story problems (Cognitively Guided Instruction) with concrete–pictorial–abstract progression
lessons.visuals: Area models: circles (pizza, pastel) and rectangle bars (chocolate, tiras de papel) divided equally vs unequally

lessons.title: Lección 2: Mitades, tercios y cuartos
lessons.goal: Recognize and name halves, thirds, quarters and eighths as parts of a whole
lessons.approach: Concrete–pictorial–abstract using paper folding and fraction strips/bars
lessons.visuals: Fraction strips/bars and circle area models, grid shading

lessons.title: Lección 3: Numerador y denominador
lessons.goal: Read, write and interpret numerator and denominator vocabulary and notation
lessons.approach: Worked examples followed by faded practice with bar models
lessons.visuals: Fraction bars and area models labeled with numerator/denominator, simple TikZ bar diagrams

units.review_focus: Identifying equal partitions, reading/writing fractions, and explaining numerator vs denominator

units.title: Unidad 2: Fracciones en la recta y en colecciones
units.summary: Vas a ver las fracciones en la recta numérica y cuando son parte de un grupo de objetos.
objectives: Ubicar fracciones entre 0 y 1 en la recta numérica
Encontrar la fracción de una colección de objetos

lessons.title: Lección 1: Fracciones unitarias
lessons.goal: Understand unit fractions (1/b) as one of b equal parts and build non-unit fractions from them
lessons.visuals: Fraction strips/bars and circle area models showing iteration of unit fractions

lessons.title: Lección 2: La recta numérica del 0 al 1
lessons.goal: Place and read proper fractions on a 0-1 number line
lessons.approach: Number line as measurement model with worked examples
lessons.visuals: Number lines from 0 to 1 partitioned into halves, thirds, quarters, sixths and eighths

lessons.title: Lección 3: Fracciones de una colección
lessons.goal: Find a fraction of a discrete set (e.g., 1/3 of 12 canicas)
lessons.approach: Equal-sharing story problems with bar models and grouping
lessons.visuals: Discrete set models (dots, canicas, lápices) grouped in circles and bar models

units.review_focus: Unit fractions, locating fractions on 0-1 number line, and fractions of a discrete set

units.title: Unidad 3: Comparar y ordenar fracciones
units.summary: Vas a comparar fracciones para saber cuál es más grande o más pequeña usando dibujos y rectas.
objectives: Comparar fracciones con el mismo denominador
Comparar fracciones con el mismo numerador
Ordenar fracciones de menor a mayor

lessons.title: Lección 1: Comparar con el mismo denominador
lessons.goal: Compare fractions with same denominator using the size of the parts
lessons.approach: Pictorial comparison with area models and fraction strips/bars, worked examples
lessons.visuals: Fraction bars and circle area models with same whole and same partition size

lessons.title: Lección 2: Comparar con el mismo numerador
lessons.goal: Compare fractions with same numerator by reasoning about size of equal parts
lessons.visuals: Fraction bars, circle area models and number lines showing different denominators

lessons.title: Lección 3: Ordenar fracciones
lessons.goal: Order 3-4 proper fractions with same numerator or same denominator
lessons.approach: Number line and bar model reasoning with faded practice
lessons.visuals: Number lines and fraction strips/bars aligned to same whole

units.review_focus: Comparing fractions with same denominator or same numerator and ordering them with visual justification

units.title: Unidad 4: Fracciones que valen lo mismo
units.summary: Vas a descubrir que dos fracciones diferentes pueden valer lo mismo y cómo encontrarlas.
objectives: Encontrar fracciones equivalentes doblando o dividiendo las partes
Ubicar fracciones equivalentes en la recta numérica

lessons.title: Lección 1: Descubrir fracciones equivalentes con tiras y círculos
lessons.goal: Recognize visually that 1/2 = 2/4, 1/3 = 2/6 etc. using same-sized wholes
lessons.approach: Concrete–pictorial–abstract with fraction strips/bars and area models
lessons.visuals: Fraction strips/bars stacked and circle area models of same size, grid shading

lessons.title: Lección 2: Doblar y partir para encontrar equivalentes
lessons.goal: Generate equivalent fractions by partitioning each part into 2 or 3 smaller equal parts
lessons.approach: Worked examples followed by faded practice using area models
lessons.visuals: Rectangle bar models and circle models showing subdivision of each part

lessons.title: Lección 3: Equivalentes en la recta numérica
lessons.goal: Identify equivalent fractions as same point on the number line
lessons.approach: Number line model with spaced review of previous units
lessons.visuals: Number lines with dual partitions (e.g., halves and quarters, thirds and sixths) aligned

units.review_focus: Visual recognition and generation of simple equivalent fractions and locating them on the number line (denominators 2, 3, 4, 6, 8)
